verdict.rationale: Apple documents several official SDKs/frameworks developers can build against on M4 Pro hardware — Metal (GPU compute/ML), Core ML, MLX, and PyTorch backend support — giving AI-native developers real official APIs to target. However, the evidence is purely first-party marketing/dev-portal blurbs with no independent hands-on corroboration of building an AI app, and a probe shows no llms.txt/AI-specific docs endpoint exists. Missing for 10: independent developer reports of building against these SDKs, deeper API reference evidence, and an AI-specific documentation surface (llms.txt returned 404).
